name: highlight-selected
author: lumine-code
description: Highlight all occurrences of the selected text.

minimumLength.title: Minimum Length
minimumLength.description: Minimum number of characters in selection before highlights are shown

maximumHighlights.title: Maximum Highlights
maximumHighlights.description: For performance purposes, the number of highlights is limited. Set to 0 for unlimited.

timeout.title: Debounce Timer
timeout.description: Debounce timer in ms before searching; resets on each selection change
